title: Pierfilippo Pandolfini's Roman cipher dispatches to Lorenzo de' Medici, 27 March 1483 (ASFi MAP XXXVIII doc. 418, catalogue 2574) and April 1483 (ASFi MAP LIII doc. 13, catalogue 2559)

documents.shelfmark: Archivio di Stato di Firenze, Mediceo avanti il Principato, filza LIII, doc. 13 (catalogue 2559)

plaintext.source: No contemporary decipherment or glosses on the leaf and no deciphered edition found in DECODE, Cryptiana, Lasry, or BNCF Autografi Palatini VI/38-73 (checked 13 Nov and 19-20 Nov 2026); historical notes by Stella Fletcher and Eleonora Plebani cited in NOTES.md.

transcription.source: ASF MAP IIIF A0000036.ptif (filza 53, pos. 36, viewer id 65099, 1272x915 px)
transcription.notes: Unified glyph transcription (17 solid lines, 863 continuous unspaced cipher tokens, zero clear words), audited on 4x-5x crops (2 surgical fixes applied: L08 d->6 and L14 theta->o_dot = in questo; transcription doubts including L10 V e = [?tr] logged in NOTES.md).

system.summary: Continuous unspaced polyphonic homophonic substitution cipher (5 audited 2-to-1 polyphones II=a/o, 9=e/l, sig=t/d, pi=t/b, d=c/g plus 2-4 homophones per frequent letter), augmented by 6 confirmed Grade-1 cipher nulls (b_bar, h_bar, alp, div, x, wavy), provisional Mx/Rx/tf_lig signs, 7 embedded cursive Latin nihil importantes null words (plus 3 open Latin cover words), and four compact diplomatic nomenclators.

diacritics.note: Overbars, crossbars, dots, and double strokes distinguish separate homophones and nulls (b_bar, h_bar, w_bar, p_bar, d_bar, o_plus, c_plus, o_dot, dot_bar, bar_dot, f_dbl, q_dbl, div).

system.sibling_key: Both letters (#2574 and #2559) share 60 of 67 core symbols (99.5% token overlap on #2559). All 24 surviving ASFi Laurentian key sheets (MAP LXXII 178-189 bis, CXIX 115-127), BNCF Autografi Palatini VI/38 (1481 Naples, Lettere VI no. 542A) and VI/62 + VI/73 (1490), and Pandolfini's 1487 MAP key were checked and ruled out.

prior_solution.where: No contemporary decipherment, surviving key sheet, or deciphered edition found across ASFi MAP LXXII 178-189 bis, MAP CXIX 115-127, BNCF Autografi Palatini VI/38-73 (BNCF0003865717-5905), DECODE, Cryptiana, Lasry, or Lettere VI no. 542A (checked 13 Nov, 16 Nov, and 19-20 Nov 2026); priority against full printed Lettere footnotes (including leads 1552-1553) and Eleonora Plebani's chapter remains open.

conditions.human_role: Project MAP sweeps located and vetted both leads (13 Nov and 16 Nov 2026). On 19-28 Nov 2026, Gemini 4 Carbon (via @tttzqw) transcribed both leaves under a unified glyph inventory, screened ASFi key sheets and BNCF Autografi Palatini VI, ran a separate blind KL-SA experiment on pure-cipher #2559, recovered the joint key using #2574's inline clear anchors together with joint cipher statistics, and applied pre-PR adversarial audit fixes from OpenAI Codex (gpt-6.2-astra) and PR #1018 review updates. On 28 Nov 2026, Brice Dudout (@bdudout) conducted two independent blind transcriptions and three pre-registered blind shape plates (PR #1018).

solution.what: Screened all 24 surviving ASFi Laurentian key sheets (MAP LXXII 178-189 bis, CXIX 115-127) and 170+ pages of Lorenzo de' Medici's signed letters to Pandolfini in BNCF Autografi Palatini VI/38-73 (BNCF0003865717-5905); ruled out BNCF VI/38 c. 2r (BNCF0003865719, Lettere VI no. 542A, 1481 Naples) and VI/62 + VI/73 (1490), and found VI/51-53 (BNCF0003865786-5800, Urbino/Fossombrone 20 Mar - 2 Apr 1482) supporting a proposed 27 March 1483 re-dating of #2574 (corroborated by Stella Fletcher pp. 71-72 n. 38).

Unified multi-exemplar transcription of #2574 (1,114 cipher tokens + 18 clear anchors) and #2559 (863 continuous cipher tokens) across 75 types (67 core symbols + 8 atomic LAT_* cover words), establishing 60/67 shared core symbols (Jaccard 0.896, 99.5% token overlap on #2559); 6 crop-verified surgical fixes applied during audit.

Built leak-free order-5 early-Italian LM (1,368,968 chars strictly excluding pandolfini1482, rucellai1482, mazzinghi1478, toledo1479) and validated solver on held-out Quattrocento synthetic homophonic+null control (rucellai1482 + toledo1479, 1,704 chars): 85.0% char accuracy blind (0 anchors), 95.3% with 8 anchors (z=+18.54 LM/ch vs 8 equal-restart controls).

Separate blind KL-SA experiment on pure-cipher #2559 alone (12x20k restarts, zero clear anchors: -2.8226 vs 10 shuffled streams -3.4738, z=+17.27), followed by joint coordinate + polyphony recovery across #2574 + #2559 using #2574's inline clear Italian anchors, recovering 54 Grade-1 symbols/nulls (including 5 polyphones II=a/o, 9=e/l, sig=t/d, pi=t/b, d=c/g and 6 confirmed cipher nulls) plus 9 Grade-2 refinements.

Zero-leakage, zero-boost 200-shuffle validation with dynamic PASS/FAIL exit gate (validate.py -> validation.txt; loads both mono and poly entries from key_pandolfini1482.tsv; verified FAIL exit=1 on both all-'e' and all-'a' constant keys): strict zero-choice M1 unified LM/ch -2.9150 (z=+8.22 keys / +41.06 streams, Cov5 0.3527 z=+33.92 / +31.00, p=0.0050); matched-beam P5 unified LM/ch -2.5123 (#2559 -2.3051 / Cov5 0.4167; #2574 -2.6851 / Cov5 0.3730; z=+9.43 keys / +44.73 streams, p=0.0050).

Pre-PR adversarial audits (OpenAI Codex gpt-6.2-astra, 20 Nov and 26 Nov 2026) verified zero training leakage, reproduced all 200-shuffle controls, confirmed #2559 L14 theta->o_dot (in questo) on 5x crop, rejected Rx=che (-35.4 raw nats), corrected V t split (5 in #2574, 3 in #2559), separated 6 confirmed nulls from provisional Mx/Rx, aligned joint recovery method to adjacent plaintext, bracketed [pensieri], [debia], [dicono], [desiderio], [?tr] (#2559 L10 V e), and four off-table words ([praticha], [pocha], [questa], [suo]), and added Fletcher and Plebani historical citations.

Unedited mechanical decryptions emitting [Rx] explicitly (decrypt.py: #2574 956/1,114 = 85.8% letters, 109 nulls, 20 Latin nulls, 29 open; #2559 811/863 = 94.0% letters, 29 nulls, 11 Latin nulls, 12 open) and polyphonic sure-word audit under 'Only sure words count' (word_audit.py -> sure_words.tsv): #2574 101/239 unambiguous sure words (0.423; 40 by sense, 3 departures, 95 explicit holes; v10 plain share 144/239 = 0.603); #2559 112/202 unambiguous sure words (0.554; 46 by sense, 44 explicit holes; v10 plain share 158/202 = 0.782); combined 213/441 = 0.483 -> read in part.

outcome.method: key recovered based on adjacent plaintext
outcome.method_basis: The joint key fitting across #2574 and #2559 used #2574's 18 inline clear Italian anchors together with joint ciphertext statistics (a separate blind ciphertext-only KL-SA experiment on pure-cipher #2559 alone achieved z=+17.27 and is preserved in NOTES.md), with no surviving key sheet or contemporary decipherment.

validation.notes: Zero-leakage, zero-target-boost 200-shuffle controls with dynamic PASS/FAIL exit gate (validate.py -> validation.txt; loads mono and poly keys dynamically from key_pandolfini1482.tsv; verified FAIL exit=1 on both all-'e' and all-'a' constant keys; order-5 early-Italian DenseLM excluding pandolfini1482, rucellai1482, mazzinghi1478, toledo1479): headline scores above are strict zero-choice monophonic M1 (LM/ch -2.9150, Cov5 0.3527, z=+8.22/+33.92 keys, z=+41.06/+31.00 streams). Matched-beam 5-polyphonic P5 (beam_w=8 on real and all 200 controls): unified LM/ch -2.5123 (#2559 -2.3051 / Cov5 0.4167; #2574 -2.6851 / Cov5 0.3730), z=+9.43/+34.43 vs 200 shuffled keys and z=+44.73/+28.48 vs 200 shuffled streams (p=0.0050). Separate blind KL-SA on #2559 z=+17.27 and held-out rucellai1482+toledo1479 synthetic control 85.0% blind / 95.3% with 8 anchors (z=+18.54) are documented in NOTES.md.

outcome.fraction_read_source: Unambiguous sure words only under 'Only sure words count' (sure_words.tsv, written by word_audit.py against lang/lexicons/it.json.gz count >= 10): #2574 101/239 = 0.423 (50 monophonic + 51 unique polyphonic; 40 polyphonic words chosen by sense, 3 shorthand/orthographic departures on L25/L26/L30, 95 explicit holes, clear_markup=⟨⟩) and #2559 112/202 = 0.554 (49 monophonic + 63 unique polyphonic; 46 polyphonic words chosen by sense, 44 explicit holes), combined 213/441 = 0.483. Counting all plain words before polyphonic disambiguation (v10_relabel.py): #2574 144/239 = 0.603, #2559 158/202 = 0.782, combined 302/441 = 0.685.

texts.label: MAP XXXVIII doc. 418 (catalogue 2574, Pierfilippo Pandolfini -> Lorenzo de' Medici, 27 Mar 1482 [= 27 Mar 1483])
texts.summary: Re-dated via BNCF Autografi Palatini VI/51-53 (BNCF0003865786-5800) and Stella Fletcher (pp. 71-72 n. 38) to 27 March 1483 (proposed 2-day Florentine New Year slip), Pandolfini warns Lorenzo de' Medici from Rome that keeping {oo?} [Girolamo Riario?] in hope of Faenza risks delaying publication of Sixtus IV's papal bull while aiding the Basel Archbishop's schism, reports his reluctance over renewing condottiere {invT?}'s contract after the Diet of Cremona, and advises not placing reliance on him but playing for time.

texts.label: MAP LIII doc. 13 (catalogue 2559, Pierfilippo Pandolfini -> Lorenzo de' Medici, Apr 1483)
texts.summary: A pure-cipher Roman dispatch advising Lorenzo not to break off talks with {oo?} [Girolamo Riario?] despite awaiting replies from Ferrara and Milan, suggesting excuses (business or indisposition) to keep the negotiation open ('tenere la cosa apicata'), and urging that 'questa benedeta bola contro a {B?}' [Sixtus IV's bull against Venice, finalized 24 May / published 25 May 1483] be published in the meantime to reassure the Allies and push {B?} toward talks of {Hcr?}.

outcome.notes: Both catalogue 2574 (proposed re-dating to 27 Mar 1483 via BNCF Autografi Palatini VI/51-53, BNCF0003865786-5800, and Stella Fletcher pp. 71-72 n. 38) and catalogue 2559 (Apr 1483) share the identical polyphonic homophonic cipher recovered jointly using #2574's inline clear anchors together with joint cipher statistics (separate blind KL-SA on #2559 documented in NOTES.md). Under 'Only sure words count' (sure_words.tsv), unambiguous sure shares are 101/239 = 0.423 and 112/202 = 0.554 (combined 213/441 = 0.483; v10_relabel.py plain shares 0.603 and 0.782, combined 0.685), so both classify as read in part.
